facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science and Technology and Innovation signed an MoU with Vodacom and unveiled a 4G-enabled digital library (Insight Centre) at the State Library in Maseru, equipped with 10 computers, a Braille printer and eye-tracking assistive technology for persons with disabilities.
facts.system: 4G-enabled digital library (Insight Centre), State Library, Maseru

systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communications, Science and Technology and Innovation with Vodacom
